title: Nonlinear Landau damping for the two-species screened Vlasov-Poisson system with large initial distributions
summary: We investigate nonlinear Landau damping for the two-species screened Vlasov-Poisson system with large initial distributions on the phase space $\mathbb{R}^d \times \mathbb{R}^d$ (where $d \geq 3$). Under a structural quasi-neutrality condition, we establish the existence and uniqueness of global strong solutions to the two-species system with arbitrarily large initial distributions.
